limitations: One cardholder account with one card at one synthetic issuer per App instance. Merchants and the issuer's staff are not accounts: what they do arrives as events.
A purchase arrives already approved. The App does not approve or decline purchases, and it has no spend controls, virtual cards or authorized users.
No card number, interest formula, late-fee rule or credit score. Interest and fees are amounts that the issuer posts.
Money does not move. A payment is a record, and the bank account that pays it is a label.
The issuer's service desk and the partner programs for points are outside the App. A dispute has no request for information.
MCP only: no GUI and no console for the issuer or a merchant.
The App has no timer and no scheduler. Posted and skipped payments, expired offers, windows, deadlines and due times are computed from the supplied virtual time.
No files, images or attachments: resources are not used.
Email is the only notification channel. Notifications reach Mail only through the Infra-run sender and Messaging. The App itself delivers nothing.
